title: Research report
idea: Research report: A meaningful finding introduces a readable report excerpt, then methods, limits and source links.
audience: People who need to read findings within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: Evidence and methodology are central to the visitor decision.
avoidWhen: The report cannot substantiate the headline.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic document layout through its read findings priority and explicit commitment contract: Distinguish results, interpretation and uncertainty; never invent study participants.
navigation: Research report keeps the current read findings context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A meaningful finding introduces a readable report excerpt, then methods, limits and source links.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to read findings; evidence and methodology are central to the visitor decision.
composition.priority: Distinguish results, interpretation and uncertainty; never invent study participants.

imagery.role: Support the actual read findings context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use reading measure and anchored contents without a permanently wide sidebar.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the research report structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no read findings content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Distinguish results, interpretation and uncertainty; never invent study participants.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized read findings content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Distinguish results, interpretation and uncertainty; never invent study participants.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active read findings context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
